bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar's Makhana Exports Hit 7,265 Tonnes in FY 2025-26 - HinduPost
bihar_raw_news.content: Business & Economy Bharat Positive Bihar’s Makhana Exports Hit 7,265 Tonnes in FY 2025-26 November 1, 2026 Web Desk Image: Beats in Brief Facebook X WhatsApp ReddIt Telegram Summary: Beats in Brief, in a report by Dipanshu Chaturvedi, says Bihar's makhana (fox nut) exports reached 7,264.89 tonnes in FY 2025-26, with the US, Canada and UAE taking about 77% of shipments. The piece traces the crop's growth in Mithilanchal, Seemanchal and the Kosi belt, rising prices, the role of Mallah divers and women workers, and new central and state support such as the National Makhana Board. It also lists remaining gaps, including mechanised harvesting, common processing facilities and testing labs. Why it matters: Makhana is a traditional Mithila crop whose rising export value shows how Bharat's farm and rural economy is finding global markets, with benefits reaching local communities and producers. “From Mithila’s Ponds to Greek Docks: Bihar’s Makhana Ships 7,265 Tonnes to the World” — Beats in Brief , 1 Nov 2026 BIHAR: One tonne of makhana sourced from Purnea was shipped via Mundra to Piraeus Port in Greece. The consignment was small, yet it captures a larger shift. Notably, Bihar supplies between 85% and 90% of India’s makhana and India accounts for over 90% of world supply. Consequently, a crop once traded informally across Bihar’s wetlands now reaches shelves on several continents. India exported 7,264.89 tonnes of makhana products in FY 2025-26. Earlier official estimates were about 200 tonnes a year, though broad customs codes made the trade hard to track. Notably, dedicated HS codes introduced in 2025 now give it clear visibility. Collectively, the United States, Canada and the United Arab Emirates take about 77% of shipments. Meanwhile, the United Kingdom, Australia, Greece, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Japan add secondary markets. Additionally, tariffs help in places. Makhana enters the UAE and Australia duty-free under trade agreements and the United States charges 1.10% on plain pops. Furthermore, in Europe and the United Kingdom, makhana is moving beyond ethnic grocery stores into mainstream health food chains. Moreover, demand rests on plant-based, gluten-free snacking, with makhana offering high protein and a low glycemic index. Bihar’s base is broad. Cultivation across Mithilanchal, Seemanchal and the Kosi belt covers 35,224 hectares. Area grew about 171% between FY 2012-13 and FY 2021-22, from roughly 13,000 hectares. Similarly, popped output rose 152% over the same period to 23,656 tonnes. Meanwhile, national output reached 63,910 tonnes in FY 2024-25, with second advance estimates for FY 2025-26 at 80,590 tonnes. Notably, field cultivation in shallow lowland paddies now accounts for roughly 35% of production. Fields yield 2.6 to 3.0 tonnes of seed a hectare against 1.8 to 2.0 in ponds. They also allow rotations such as makhana, rice and wheat. Encouragingly, the Sabour Makhana-1 variety gives 32 to 35 quintals a hectare with pop recovery of 55% to 60%. bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar CM Samrat Chaudhary inaugurates Patliputra Rashtriya Yuva Sansad 2.0, calls youth ...
bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar CM Samrat Chaudhary inaugurates Patliputra Rashtriya Yuva Sansad 2.0, calls youth future of Indian democracy ANI | Updated: Nov 01, 2026 18:26 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel Patna ( Bihar ) [India], November 1 (ANI): Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary on Sunday inaugurated Patliputra Rashtriya Yuva Sansad 2.0, organised by Gyan Niketan School in Patna , emphasising the importance of youth participation in strengthening democracy and shaping India's future. He said the foundation of democracy in India was deeply connected with Bihar and acknowledged the contributions of freedom fighters who worked hard to establish democratic values in the country. He said successive generations of youth had contributed to the country's progress. Referring to the present generations, Gen Z and Gen Alpha, he said the government must work according to the aspirations, ideas and expectations of young people. Addressing the inauguration ceremony of the Patliputra Rashtriya Yuva Sansad 2.0, the Bihar CM said, “The future of Indian democracy lies in the hands of the youth. There were freedom fighters who dreamt of building India before 1947. Then, young students led the 1974 movement and worked towards taking the nation forward.” “Today, we have Gen Z and Gen Alpha. I want to tell them clearly that democracy in this country exists so that the next generation can emerge and take the lead. Through Gen Z, I want to say that this government is working solely for you. The government must work for you and your ideas,” he further said. He also highlighted Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision of a Viksit Bharat by 2047 and recalled former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar's dream of building a prosperous Bihar . "Prime Minister Narendra Modi has set the vision of making India a Viksit BharatViksit Bharat by 2047, while former Chief Minister Nitish Kumar dreamed of a prosperous Bihar ," he said. The Chief Minister said the government was providing electricity subsidies to households and urged financially capable citizens to contribute towards improving the state's education system. "I appeal to the prosperous people of Bihar , particularly those who are capable of contributing, to donate the benefit of 125 units of free electricity so that the money can be utilised to strengthen the education system," he said. He stated that the government was spending approximately Rs 18,000 crore on education and stressed the need to expand higher education opportunities within Bihar . Highlighting educational reforms, Chaudhary referred to the development of 700 model schools and the introduction of technology-based initiatives, including the Vidyarthi Sathi app, to improve communication and coordination between students and teachers. "Knowledge is the path to progress and prosperity. Once you acquire knowledge, nobody can stop you from achieving prosperity," he said, encouraging students to focus on education and learning. Concluding his address, Chaudhary reiterated that democracy derives its strength from the people and that the younger generation must play an active role in determining the country's future. (ANI)

bihar_raw_news.title: Sardar Patel Statue Patna: Bihar Announces Tallest Statue - Urban Acres
bihar_raw_news.content: Home Breaking News Patna to Get Bihar’s Tallest Sardar Patel Statue, CM Announces Breaking News Patna to Get Bihar’s Tallest Sardar Patel Statue, CM Announces By Urban Acres November 1, 2026 0 Copy URL Facebook Linkedin X WhatsApp Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary has announced that the state government will install a statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Patna, describing it as the tallest statue of any eminent personality in Bihar. The announcement was made at a Rashtriya Ekta Diwas programme at Bapu Sabhagar, where the chief minister said the project would honour Patel’s role in uniting India. Choudhary said the statue would be the largest among those of eminent personalities established in Bihar so far. The chief minister did not disclose the proposed height, exact location, construction cost, agency responsible for execution or completion timeline in the announcement reported by the Times of India. The programme was organised by Sajhi Virasat Abhiyan to mark Patel’s birth anniversary. Choudhary paid floral tributes to Patel’s portrait and described him as a symbol of unity and one of India’s strongest home ministers. He referred to Patel’s role in merging more than 560 princely states into India and strengthening the country’s unity and integrity. “Among the statues of great men established in Bihar so far, the largest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Ji will be installed,” Choudhary said at the event. He also said Patel had performed the historic task of binding the country “from Kashmir to Kanyakumari” into one thread. The proposed installation places a commemorative structure within Patna’s wider civic landscape, but the announcement does not yet establish how the project will be planned, funded or integrated into the city’s public spaces. Details on land allocation, design, procurement, construction supervision and maintenance were not provided in the report. Choudhary linked the announcement to the broader national objective of building a developed and economically strong India by 2047. He said continuous efforts were being made under Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s leadership towards that goal, and credited Modi and former Bihar chief minister Nitish Kumar with work connected to Patel’s vision and development in Bihar. Health Minister Nishant Kumar also addressed the gathering and recalled Patel’s contribution to the making of India. During the event, Choudhary told Nishant Kumar that the two would work together like “brothers” to take Bihar forward. The remark comes amid discussions over Nishant Kumar’s role after he took charge of the health department, according to the report. The next publicly disclosed steps for the statue project, including its site, dimensions, budget and implementation schedule, remain awaited. Until those details are announced, the chief minister’s statement establishes the government’s intention to build the statue but not the project’s execution framework. bihar_raw_news.title: Nishant Kumar on JDU's plan ahead of 2027 assembly elections - India Gazette
bihar_raw_news.content: "We plan to expand our organisation in Uttar Pradesh": Nishant Kumar on JDU's plan ahead of 2027 assembly elections ANI 31 Oct 2026, 19:03 GMT+10 Patna (Bihar) [India], October 31 (ANI): Bihar Health Minister Nishant Kumar on Saturday said that the Janata Dal (United) plans to expand its organisational presence in Uttar Pradesh and is considering contesting the 2027 Assembly elections as a constituent of the National Democratic Alliance (NDA). Speaking about the party's plans, Nishant Kumar said party workers and people in Uttar Pradesh had been demanding a meeting in the state for a long time, following which the party decided to organise one. "For a long time, people and party workers in Uttar Pradesh had been demanding that a meeting be held there. So, we are going to organise a meeting. Our party has its roots in Bihar, but we have also had an organisational presence in other states across the country, particularly in the Northeast," he said. He added that the party now intends to strengthen its organisational presence in Uttar Pradesh and expand its activities in the state. "We now plan to expand our organisation in Uttar Pradesh, strengthen our presence there and move forward. The Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections are scheduled for 2027, and we are considering contesting them," he said. On the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Nishant Kumar said the party was considering contesting the polls and would make efforts to do so as an NDA constituent. "We will make an effort to contest the elections as a constituent of the NDA," he added. Nishant Kumar also congratulated the NDA candidates who won the recent MLC elections, saying the BJP's victory in two seats and JD(U)'s win in one seat reflected public appreciation for the work done by his father and the NDA over the past 20 years. "I extend my heartiest congratulations and best wishes to all the NDA candidates who won in the recent MLC elections. The two seats won by the BJP and the one seat won by us reflect the public's appreciation for the work carried out by my father and the NDA over the last 20 years," he said. "As for our losses, we will review the reasons behind them and strive to address any shortcomings," he added. national_raw_news.title: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flags off Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Train; Says, it...
national_raw_news.content: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw today flagged off the Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Train at Sir M. Visvesvaraya Terminal in Bengaluru, Karnataka. Union Ministers Pralhad Joshi, H.D. Kumaraswamy, Shobha Karandlaje, and V Somanna were also present on the occasion. Speaking at the event, Mr. Vaishnaw said that the train will seamlessly connect India’s IT and startup hub with its financial capital. The 16-coach Bengaluru-Mumbai Sleeper Vande Bharat train will cover the journey between the two cities in around 16 hours. The train will run six days a week, except Mondays from Bengaluru and Tuesdays from Mumbai. It will stop at Anantapur, Guntakal, Raichur, Yadgir, Kalaburagi, Solapur, Pune, and Kalyan. Mr. Vaishnaw said this route covers parts of Northern Karnataka that were previously unserved by a world-class train. Mr. Vaishnaw also said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi hasapproved the bullet train’s south corridor for Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Amravati, and Chennai. He added that once completed, travel time from Bengaluru to Chennai will be 73 minutes. Furthermore, Mr. Vaishnaw said the Mangaluru to Bengaluru Vande Bharat will be operational within the next few weeks. The Vande Bharat Sleeper train offers First AC, AC Two-Tier, and AC Three-Tier accommodation, with cushioned berths, integrated reading lights, mobile charging points, and ample luggage space. Passengers will benefit from touch-free bio-vacuum toilets, automatic doors, onboard infotainment, and GPS-based passenger information displays. First AC coaches will additionally offer hot-water shower facilities. For passenger safety, the train is equipped with CCTV cameras, fire detection systems, and emergency communication facilities.

national_raw_news.title: President says Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao Campaign marks milestone in women’s empowerment; Attends ...
national_raw_news.content: President Droupadi Murmu has said that the nationwide Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao campaign has proved to be an important milestone in promoting women’s empowerment. The Campaign was launched from Panipat in Haryana in January 2015. She highlighted that the Child Sex Ratio at birth, which stood at 871 girls per one thousand boys in 2014, has increased to around 915 in November 2025. President Murmu said this while addressing the state-level Haryana Day celebrations in Kurukshetra, marking the 60th anniversary of the formation of Haryana. She said that Haryana has made remarkable progress over the past decade invarious dimensions of women’s empowerment. President Murmu said that Haryana’s daughters have brought laurels to the country at international sporting events. She highlighted that countless daughters, including Manu Bhaker, Saweety Boora and Jaismine Lamboria, are making Haryana and the nation proud through their remarkable achievements. The President said that the athletes from Haryana have made exceptional contributions to India’s sporting history, achieving outstanding success at the Olympic Games, Paralympic Games, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games and World Championships. Speaking on the occasion, Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini said that hardworking farmers, brave soldiers, accomplished sportspersons and empowered women are the identity of Haryana. He said that when Haryana was formed on this day in 1966, it was considered a backward region. However, today Haryana is counted among the leading states of the country. Mr Saini said that this achievement belongs not to any one individual but to the collective efforts of farmers, labourers, entrepreneurs, traders, sportspersons and women. He said that the daughters of Haryana are bringing laurels to the state in every field, from agriculture and sports to the armed forces and start-ups. Mr. Saini highlighted that Haryana contributes approximately 3.6 per cent to India’s GDP. He said that the state has become the first in the country to procure 24 crops from farmers at the Minimum Support Price. The Chief Minister said that Haryana’s sportspersons have made the country proud on the international stage.

national_raw_news.title: SEBI Steps Up Measures to Protect Investors from Online Financial Fraud 31 Oct 2026 | 6:30 PM 168
national_raw_news.content: The Securities and Exchange Board of India, SEBI, is taking several steps to protect investors from online financial fraud and scams through social media. Speaking to the media in Kolkata, SEBI Chairman Mr. Tuhin Kanta Pandey said, the regulator is working to make investors more aware and ensure safer investments. As part of these efforts, SEBI is working with Google to introduce special verified badges on the Google Play Store so that people can identify genuine SEBI-related apps. SEBI has also started a WhatsApp channel on investor awareness in eleven languages, including Bengali. The SEBI Saarthi App and SEBI Check facility will help investors check and verify accounts before making transactions in the securities market. SEBI has also developed an artificial intelligence-based tool called ‘Sudarshan’. It will help identify violations and suspicious activities across social media platforms through a five-stage checking process. The regulator is also running the ‘Samajh ke Investing Simple’ campaign in different regional languages to help people understand investments better. In addition, the SCORES 2.0 portal has been introduced to help investors register complaints, including complaints related to financial fraud. Speaking about West Bengal’s economic growth, Mr. Pandey said the state’s economy is estimated to have grown by 7.6 per cent in the financial year 2025-26. He also pointed out that the number of investors from West Bengal in the securities market has increased significantly. The number has crossed 90 lakh, compared to around 12 lakh in the financial year 2014-15. Interestingly, around 36 per cent of these investors are below 30 years of age. He further said that more than 40 small and medium-sized businesses from West Bengal have raised over 1,400 crore rupees through SME Initial Public Offerings, or IPOs. These figures show the growing interest of people in the state’s financial and investment markets. Mr. Pandey said, investor awareness and protection remain SEBI’s top priorities. The regulator aims to make the securities market safer and help people make informed investment decisions. However the chairman made it clear that the revival of the century-old Calcutta Stock Exchange will depend on its ability to attract sufficient trading volumes, build a sustainable business model and make substantial investments in technology.

national_raw_news.title: Vice President CP Radhakrishnan inaugurates National Organ Transplant Games 2026 3 hours ago 48
national_raw_news.content: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan today inaugurated the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 at Talkatora Stadium in New Delhi. Addressing the event, the Vice President described the Games as a celebration of courage, determination, compassion and the precious gift of life. Mr. Radhakrishnan also described organ donation as a ‘Mahadaan’, through which hope can endure even in the face of loss. He said that the organ donation movement in India has received significant impetus from the consistent emphasis placed on the subject by Prime Minister Narendra Modi through his ‘Mann Ki Baat’ addresses. The Vice President emphasised that the Games celebrate the resilience of transplant recipients and demonstrate the life-transforming power of modern medicine. He also commended the participants for their courage, discipline and sporting spirit, noting that their achievements inspire hope among those awaiting transplantation. Calling for greater awareness about organ donation, the Vice President stressed the need to dispel myths and misconceptions, encourage informed decisions and motivate people to share their wishes with their families. He further called upon everyone to make organ donation a powerful expression of shared humanity and work towards a society where more patients receive transplants and fewer lives are lost while waiting for organs. He also paid his deepest respects to deceased organ donors and their families, whose selfless decisions give others a second chance at life. Mr. Radhakrishnan appreciated living donors for exemplifying the finest values of love and compassion. He added that one deceased organ donor can save up to eight lives. On the occasion, Mr. Radhakrishnan witnessed an attempt to set a world record, featuring 570 transplant recipients and donors performing Tadasana together. Following the successful attempt, the organisers were presented with a certificate by the World Book of Records, New Delhi, for the ‘Largest Congregation of Transplant Recipients and Donors Performing Tadasana’. During the programme, the Vice President released the ‘Zindagi Dobara’ Calendar and felicitated the medal winners of the World Transplant Games 2025, held in Dresden, Germany. He also joined the gathering in taking the Organ Donation Pledge and witnessed exhibition matches in Kabaddi, Table Tennis and Badminton. Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare Prataprao Jadhav was also present on the occasion.

national_raw_news.title: Centre constitutes high-level committee to recommend banking reforms for Viksit Bharat 2047 31 Oct 2026 | 7:40 AM 448
national_raw_news.content: The government has constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat to review the country’s banking sector and recommend reforms in line with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. The Finance Ministry said that the Committee will recommend structural, institutional, regulatory and legislative reforms to make the Indian banking sector globally competitive, financially inclusive and resilient. The Committee will be chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel. Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu, former Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Indian Bank Padmaja Chunduru, and former RBI Deputy Governor N. S. Vishwanathan will be its members. The Joint Secretary (Banking) in the Department of Financial Services will serve as the Member Secretary. The Committee will have a tenure of six months. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman had announced the setting up of the Committee in her Budget speech this year. The Committee will assess existing banking practices and prudential norms, identify global best practices and examine their suitability for adoption in the Indian banking system. It will also review the existing regulatory and legal frameworks governing banks, including Regional Rural Banks and Cooperative Banks, and suggest reforms to improve efficiency and ease of banking. In addition, the Committee will prepare a roadmap for the adoption of artificial intelligence and digital innovations in banking institutions, while recommending safeguards against cyber risks.

national_raw_news.title: Filmmaker Alleges Cheating In Doordarshan Project: PIB Media Assistant, 3 Others Named ...
national_raw_news.content: Filmmaker Alleges Cheating In Doordarshan Project: PIB Media Assistant, 3 Others Named In Chargesheet | Republic World LIVE TV News / India News / Filmmaker Alleges Cheating In Doordarshan Project: PIB Media Assistant, 3 Others Named In Chargesheet Updated 1 November 2026 at 05:55 IST Delhi Police chargesheeted 4 persons for allegedly cheating a Mumbai filmmaker on the pretext of a Doordarshan project under Prasar Bharati’s DAP policy using fake official identities and parallel proposals. Abhishek Tiwari India News 5 min read Follow : Filmmaker Alleges Cheating In Doordarshan Project: PIB Media Assistant, 3 Others Named In Chargesheet | Image: AI Generated/ Representational New Delhi: The Delhi police have filed a chargesheet against 4 people in connection with an alleged cheating, impersonation and conspiracy case involving purported production opportunities under Prasar Bharati’s Direct Assignment Process (DAP) policy. The case centres on Mumbai-based filmmaker Bhavesh Parmar’s allegation that he was induced to pay money after being offered work connected with Doordarshan. According to the chargesheet filed before the Saket court, the case originated from a meeting at Soochna Bhawan. As per the allegations by the complainant, he was allegedly informed that his project could be submitted under the DAP policy. Following the assurance, money was allegedly collected through multiple bank transactions between August and November 2022 against assurances of registration and budgetary approvals for a proposed 26-episode series. The police investigation has alleged involvement of 4 persons, including individuals who purportedly posed as the officials linked to government media bodies to facilitate the process, while also examining the role of a 5th person who has not been chargesheeted at this stage. The probe has flagged alleged parallel proposals filed under the DAP system using proxy names to displace the original producer. Read ahead to know more about this bullet train getting made in BEML’s Bengaluru workshop. Under the Make in India and Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiatives, Indian Railways is promoting indigenous high-speed rail manufacturing. | Image Credit: ZEE Business India’s first indigenous bullet train is taking shape in Bengaluru. At Bharat Earth Movers Limited’s workshop in the city, work on the country’s first bullet train is moving fast, based on an approved design. The train, called B 28, has already been cleared for a squeeze test, an important check for coaches that will run at very high speeds. Built under the Aatmanirbhar Bharat vision, this bullet train is designed to run at a speed of 350 km per hour and is expected to hit the tracks next year. It will run on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor. Let’s take a look at how the train is being built, why the squeeze test matters, and what lies ahead for high-speed rail in India. India’s first Bullet Train built at BEML Bengaluru Construction of the bullet train is going on at full speed in BEML’s Bengaluru workshop, and the work follows an approved design. Every part of the train has gone through three-level certification. The makers are also following all existing global standards strictly. The Integral Coach Factory (ICF) is working with Bharat Earth Movers Limited (BEML) to design and manufacture indigenous high-speed train sets. A newly inaugurated complex in Bengaluru, named Aditya, is designed for the development of these B-28 coaches. What is a Squeeze Test and why is it compulsory? When a train runs at very high speed, a vacuum forms around it. This vacuum puts pressure on the body of the coach. To make sure the coach can handle it, a squeeze test is compulsory for bullet trains. The B 28 has completed this test. This is a big step, as it shows the coach body can bear the strain of high-speed travel. B 28 Bullet Train speed and features The B 28 is designed to run at 350 km per hour. national_raw_news.title: EPFO's 74-year journey built on trust, service and commitment to workers: Mansukh Mandaviya
national_raw_news.content: EPFO's 74-year journey built on trust, service and commitment to workers: Mansukh Mandaviya Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर EPFO's 74-year journey built on trust, service and commitment to workers: Mansukh Mandaviya ANI | Updated: Nov 01, 2026 16:49 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], November 1 (ANI): Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) celebrated its 74th Foundation Day on Sunday at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi, marking its journey from a statutory provident fund organisation to one of India's foremost social security institutions, with a renewed commitment to technology-enabled service delivery, compassion in governance and the welfare of millions of workers and pensioners. Addressing the gathering, Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted that over its 74-year journey, EPFO has emerged as a trusted institution for the workforce of the country. Mandaviya noted that the trust reposed in the Organisation is reflected in the ₹32 lakh crore corpus accumulated through contributions from more than 8 crore members, made possible by the dedication, hard work and commitment of the EPFO workforce. Emphasising that social security must be driven by human sensitivity, Mandaviya stressed that every concern and grievance of workers must be addressed with compassion and empathy, viewing each worker with the respect and dignity they deserve as nation-builders. Commending the relentless efforts behind technological transformations like CITES 2.01, he called upon every official to focus on the welfare of the worker at the last mile. Union Minister Mandaviya urged officials to take inspiration from the ‘Panch Pran’ articulated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. "Seva is our sanskaar," Mandaviya underlined, and encouraged all to contribute towards accomplishing the goal of Viksit Bharat. The Union Minister urged officials to focus on worker-centric innovations across domains in the run-up to EPFO's 75th year, adapting, building resilience, and evolving processes in tandem with changing times. He also extended Diwali greetings and wished for the light of success and prosperity in the lives of all EPFO officials, members and beneficiaries. The Secretary, Ministry of Labour & Employment, Chandra Bhushan Kumar stated that EPFO, in over seven decades of service to the nation, has laid the foundation of and strengthened India's social security framework, creating a model worth emulating for coming generations. He emphasised that social protection and labour reforms must reach not just the organised sector, but unorganised sector workers at the last mile, noting that EPFO sets an example of how to achieve this through institutionalised processes. Observing that the day provides an opportunity to reflect on how far we have come and how far we have to go, he stressed that reform is a continuous process and requires constant evolution in the current digital age in order to effectively solve the common man's problems. He called upon officials associated with these reforms to adapt their mindset and perspective in tandem, prioritising accessibility and ease of living for beneficiaries as collective efforts continue toward attaining the goal of Viksit Bharat @2047.
